name: windy-plugin-snowline-map-100m
description: v200 convenience-first terrain-aware wintry forecast. Five-second answers for precipitation type, terrain, snowline, precipitation, estimated new snow and timing, with a clean forecast timeline and optional sounding.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && SERVE=false rollup -c && cp package.json dist/
